articles.summary: KB Home (NYSE: KBH), one of the largest and most trusted homebuilders in the U.S., today announced the opening of Morningside, a new-home community in Dade City, Florida. Morningside at a Glance: Price: From the high $200,000s Location: Dade City, Florida, at the corner of US-98 and Morning Ridge Trail Home type: One- and two-story, single-family floor plans Bedrooms/baths: Up to 5 bedrooms and 3 baths School district: Pasco County Schools Morningside is located at the corner of US-98 and Morning Ridge Trail. The community provides easy access to US-301 and is just minutes away from AdventHealth medical center and shopping and dining along US-98. Residents will enjoy Morningside's proximity to hiking at Hillsborough River State Park and wildlife viewing at Giraffe Ranch. The homes at Morningside are designed for contemporary living, with modern kitchens overlooking large great rooms, expansive bedroom suites with walk-in closets, and lofts.
